exposure: Mothers of babies hospitalized in NICU vs. mothers of babies not hospitalized in NICU
cohort: 587 pregnant women who had their lipid profiles measured during their first trimester between January 2020 and December 2020.
finding: High levels of total cholesterol, triglycerides, LDL-C, and VLDL-C in the first trimester of pregnancy were associated with an increased need for NICU admission, but not with mode of delivery.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the rates of cesarean section and vaginal delivery in patients with respect to lipid profile levels.
birth_weight: The mean birth weight of newborns was 3280 g.
